projects.title: RevBridge AI
projects.description: Enterprise SaaS conversational AI platform automating voice conversations with intelligent AI agents for outbound/inbound calling, appointment scheduling, payment processing, real-time intent detection, and seamless CRM integrations.
projects.role: Lead Developer & Engineering Team Lead (Managed 3 Developers)
overview: I led the development of the RevBridge AI platform, managing a team of three developers throughout the project lifecycle. The platform was built using multiple technologies, including Next.js for the frontend, NestJS for the backend, and Python for AI voice agents. We also integrated several third-party services such as LiveKit, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, and Vobiz.

The platform is an AI-powered automated calling solution designed for debt recovery, marketing, promotions and payment collection. Using AI prompts and voice bots, the system automatically initiates calls to real customers, engages in natural conversations, and collects payment-related information without any human intervention. All calling activities are executed automatically during predefined business calling hours.

The system has successfully handled between 3,000 and 5,000 calls per day while maintaining detailed records of call outcomes, including answered calls, transferred calls, voicemail detection, voicemail drops, customer hang-ups, and no-answer scenarios. All call activities, recordings, transcripts, and statuses are accurately tracked and maintained for reporting and operational purposes.
keyFeatures: AI-powered outbound calling with fully automated customer interactions.
Automated payment collection workflows without human involvement.
Call transfer functionality that seamlessly transfers calls to live agents when required.
Inbound calling support, allowing customers to call dedicated campaign numbers and interact with AI voice agents.
Complete call logging and conversation tracking.
Call recording and transcript management, enabling authorized users to review customer-bot conversations from the admin panel.
CRM integration with the IDMS platform, where call outcomes and notes are automatically pushed to IDMS as call notes during and after every call.
Automated status updates and workflow execution throughout the call lifecycle.
projects.impact: Successfully processed 3,000 to 5,000 calls per day with autonomous debt collection workflows, real-time live-agent escalation, and complete CRM data synchronization.

projects.title: ShiftHarmony AI
projects.description: Multi-tenant SaaS hospital scheduling platform with automated scheduling, shift management, natural language provider preferences, CP-SAT optimization, and integrated payment systems.
projects.role: Full Stack Developer (Core Scheduling Workflows, Solver Engine, & Integrations)
overview: ShiftHarmony AI is a multi-tenant workforce scheduling platform designed to automate and optimize employee shift management. The platform is built using a multi-tenant architecture, where each onboarded organization has its own dedicated database, ensuring data isolation, security, and scalability.

Organizations can configure their scheduling rules, employee preferences, availability, and operational requirements. Based on these inputs, the platform automatically generates optimized shift schedules for one-month or three-month periods without scheduling conflicts or rule violations.

A key component of the platform is its AI-powered scheduling engine, which leverages Google's CP-SAT (Constraint Programming Solver) to create and optimize shift schedules. The system analyzes employee preferences, organizational policies, staffing requirements, working-hour constraints, and scheduling rules to generate the most efficient and conflict-free schedule.
I contributed to both the frontend and backend development of the platform, working on core scheduling workflows, integrations, and user-facing features.

The primary objective of ShiftHarmony AI is to eliminate manual scheduling efforts by intelligently analyzing employee preferences and organizational requirements to generate approved, conflict-free shift schedules. This significantly reduces administrative workload, saves time, and helps hospitals and other organizations efficiently manage doctor and employee shifts while ensuring compliance with operational rules and workforce preferences.
keyFeatures: Multi-tenant architecture with a dedicated database for each organization.
Automated shift scheduling for one-month and three-month planning periods.
AI-powered optimization using Google CP-SAT for conflict-free scheduling.
Employee preference and availability management.
Organization-specific scheduling rules and constraints.
Automatic shift rescheduling when requirements or availability change.
Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook Calendar integration for automatic schedule synchronization.
Voice chat functionality that enables users to interact with the platform more conveniently.
Real-time schedule management and workforce planning.
projects.impact: Eliminated manual scheduling overhead by over 80% across hospitals and enterprise teams, ensuring strict compliance with labor regulations and doctor preferences.

projects.title: MLC-CakePHP
projects.description: Upgraded and modernized an enterprise academic CMS platform from CakePHP 3 to CakePHP 5 via an incremental multi-stage migration, preserving existing business logic, database integrity, and production deployment via cPanel.
overview: This project involved upgrading and modernizing an existing CMS system from CakePHP 3 to CakePHP 5, followed by a successful deployment to the production server.

The migration from CakePHP 3 to CakePHP 5 involved several technical challenges, particularly because the project needed to retain its existing data, business logic, and functionality while moving to the latest framework version. Before starting the development work, a complete backup of the existing project and data was created to ensure data safety and provide a reliable rollback option.

A dedicated development environment was then configured to safely perform and test the migration. Since a direct upgrade from CakePHP 3 to CakePHP 5 was not feasible, the application was migrated incrementally—first from CakePHP 3 to CakePHP 4, and then from CakePHP 4 to CakePHP 5.

During the migration, several framework components, functions, APIs, and parts of the project directory structure had changed or were no longer compatible with the newer versions. These components were therefore recreated or refactored while preserving the same existing functionality and business behavior.

The overall objective of the upgrade was to address security and compatibility issues associated with the older framework version, modernize the application architecture, improve maintainability, and ensure that the CMS remains secure, stable, scalable, and suitable for long-term development and maintenance.
After completing the migration, testing, compatibility adjustments, and functionality verification, the upgraded CakePHP 5 application was successfully deployed to the production server.
keyFeatures: Incremental Multi-Stage Framework Upgrade: Safely bridged major breaking changes by executing a staged CakePHP 3 → 4 → 5 migration path.
Zero Data Loss & Database Integrity: Preserved all existing content hierarchies, historical articles, media assets, and relational tables.
API & Component Refactoring: Rebuilt legacy ORM queries, deprecated view helpers, routing middleware, and authentication plugins to comply with CakePHP 5 standards.
Fail-Safe Backup & Rollback Protocols: Established full snapshot backups and sandbox staging environments prior to production rollout.
Enhanced Security & Maintainability: Resolved legacy framework vulnerabilities, updated dependencies, and elevated code maintainability for long-term support.
Production cPanel Deployment: Configured Apache environment rules, PHP runtime compatibility, database credentials, and live production release on the university portal.
projects.impact: Successfully migrated the Toronto Metropolitan University MLC Research Centre & Gallery CMS to CakePHP 5 with zero downtime, safeguarding years of academic research archives while delivering enhanced security and performance.
